notes.title: Update (ver. 2.0.4) Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying [i]R-Type Final 2[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/79e6b24bc1a1ac41d59eddb98d418578abf4a41a.png[/img]

Below is a list of the details of the update (Ver. 2.0.4).

[b]1. Boss Rush Course[/b]
Boss Rush Course is a special challenge mode where you can battle all the bosses from previously appeared stages consecutively.

In the “Boss Rush Course (including homage stages),” if you own DLC, bosses from your DLC content will also be randomly selected for the boss stages.
* In “R-Type Final 2,” stage bosses from “R-Type Final 3 Evolved” do not appear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/fc338acc16c627ff94c250fb2cd4c8b32e91a735.png[/img]

[b]2. Player Ship “Standard Force”[/b]

We have added the player ship "F-A Standard Force," which closely resembles the iconic invincible lifeform "Force" that symbolizes R-Type.
This player ship was selected from a poll conducted during the June 2024 YouTube live stream event, "Gathering of Granzella 2024."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/d89b119fcf7c614f2e9a01fbbcaf8b150cc6674a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/f611ca9203a70f78d46b4263eb35e7095bbc1ddd.png[/img]

[b]3. “FIRST STEP” Difficulty Level[/b]
We have added a new difficulty level, “FIRST STEP,” with enhanced support features.
This brings the total number of difficulty levels to eight.

Even players new to R-Type can enjoy the thrill of clearing stages and the satisfaction of defeating enemies. By utilizing the SLOW function, you can learn how to use the Wave Cannon and Force effectively, and develop the skills needed to take on the next difficulty level, “PRACTICE.”

In the FIRST STEP difficulty, the following support features are available:
- Always maintain full power-up status
- Reduced charge time for the wave cannon
- SLOW function is available for use
*The SLOW function is also available in the PRACTICE difficulty level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/d89b119fcf7c614f2e9a01fbbcaf8b150cc6674a.png[/img]

[b]4. New features and multiple items added to “Pilot & War Record”[/b]

We have added a feature that allows you to display the Force in “Pilot & War Record,” along with several new items: 1/20 scale models of the R-Craft “TL-2AT,” “TH-01,” and “TL-2N,” as well as a Cactus, Plate Armor, and a Terrarium.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/dd7f335b4429d76e712b402234f0e991c0ad0fac.png[/img]▲New Feature
In “Pilot & War Record,” Force can now be displayed only when the background graphic is set to “Coastline: Sandy Beach.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/192c470bea4b048c81fd321aa832d9e23bfd6279.png[/img]▲1/20 scale models of R-Craft “TL-2AT”“TH-01”“TL-2N”
You can unlock these models by using eligible R-craft 30 times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/192c470bea4b048c81fd321aa832d9e23bfd6279.png[/img]▲“Cactus”“Plate Armor”“Terrarium”
These items can be unlocked by purchasing them from the store.

[b]5. Two types of decals that you can add to your ship[/b]
"R-Type Final 2’s 4th anniversary decal” and “R-Type Final 3 Evolved's 2nd anniversary decal” are now available.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/4e07797597c83847ebc677bc51331c76139a419d.png[/img]

[b]6. Fixed bugs in the craft ranking[/b]
The craft ranking in “Pilot & War Record” has been updated so that crafts with the same number of uses are now sorted by craft number.

[b]7. Other Improved and fixed various performance issues.[/b]
We hope you continue to enjoy “R-Type Final 2” and "R-Type Final 3 Evolved".

notes.title: Version 2.0.3 update adds a new ship, "Speed change level" and more
notes.content:
Below are the details of the latest update (Version 2.0.3).

[b]1. Added a new player ship[/b]
The humanoid fighter TL-3N NARCISSUS, which appears in the sci-fi tactical simulation game R-TYPE TACTICS II that sets in the world of R-TYPE, has been added as a player ship. Unlike other humanoid craft, it cannot transform into a flight form but has more powerful armaments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/49579e4d4d71fe96054c74bdeb6710882141418e.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/54f5a263c553f76cc56ff62e625042550b6509b6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/3a6150f0029b3edc8e9bf9cd6d2576739eda2d0f.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/8359eed4c1c910c9a36d878122ea548e1472659e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/947d61a277fcf3d2aa8896a9dddd44c18d688645.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/e6f3888bf97e1b828eb29ecf7281a06c69e21556.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/f41aeccaceb5a3bff82e2118aeadf3a4ca78fc32.png[/img][/url]

The following three conditions must be met to develop the TL-3N NARCISSUS, and the "TL-2AT," the predecessor of the TL-3N in the phylogenetic chart, must have been developed.

1) "Stage R2.0" has been completed.
2) Spend the resources necessary to develop the ship (Solonium: 450, Etherium: 450, Bydogen: 450).
3) The development of the "R-9D2" has been completed.


[b]2. "Speed change levels" have been added to the Options[/b]
Until now, the speed change of a player's ship had four levels, but now you can switch between four and seven levels in Options. The minimum and maximum speeds remain the same even with seven levels, but the speed can now be fine-tuned, so you can make the most of it to suit your playstyle. Weapons whose performance depends on the speed level remain unchanged at four levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/bfce4c9e9dec22dfea768a58f1bf132f2acd1eb9.png[/img]

[b]3. Increased the number of save slots for the 'R Album,' which saves the customized state of a player ship, from 120 to 180[/b]
Enjoy customizing your ships with the expanded R Album.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/dc887dbf71150c546678c08f568548203b21e4c5.png[/img]

[b]4. Added two backgrounds to the "Pilot & War Record"[/b]
'Coastline: Sandy Beach,' featuring the setting sun on the horizon, and the 'White-light space: Mirror,' based on the title screen of R-Type Tactics II. These backgrounds are now available for use.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/267a537e7a7044e47d2528b189f83f4eb06ea526.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/f5d443514b1439e5256c6be0fe689702b4dd006b.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/1ef95092ad4294b17e47b27772eb7c1a3b904c3c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/31b74f3b7f10abe51cf04f27cd0e1323cc3c29dc.png[/img][/url]

[b]5. Added two types of decals that you can add to your ship[/b]
'R-Type Final 2's 3rd-anniversary decal' and 'R-Type Final 3 Evolved's 1st-anniversary decal' are now available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972409/1849cf4e2a8c558dca9ecf576b7e54d559e37f84.png[/img]

Thanks for reading!
